data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement stems from a tool error in the qwen model, which failed to audit .gitignore due to an HTTP 400 BadRequestError. The deepseek model had no such error and correctly identified all three files as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .gitignore due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), resulting in incomplete coverage
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be distinguished from security inconclusiveness - a failed audit due to infrastructure issues should not contaminate the overall verdict when other files are clearly safe
Implement retry logic or fallback models when API errors occur during file audits to prevent coverage gaps
